title: The barrage at El Alamein
body:
At 9:40 p.m., nearly 900 British and Commonwealth guns opened fire at once along the line at El Alamein in Egypt.

Montgomery's Eighth Army attacked behind the barrage. Twelve days later, Rommel's army was in retreat.
photoNote: A 25 pounder gun firing during the night barrage that opened the Second Battle of El Alamein, 23 October 1942. No. 1 Army Film and Photographic Unit, IWM E 18469, public domain (Crown copyright expired).
